Overview
Bitmine Immersion Technologies, Inc. is a U.S.-based digital asset technology company operating in the digital asset industry with a strategic focus on acquiring, holding and managing digital assets as well as providing critical blockchain infrastructure services. Beginning in July 2025, we expanded our business to focus primarily on Ethereum and its native cryptocurrency, ETH, transitioning from primarily Bitcoin mining and hosting activities toward long-term accumulation, staking and optimization of our digital asset holdings. Our primary objective is to manage digital assets as long-term strategic reserves and to provide critical blockchain infrastructure services in order to further improve shareholder value. Our results of operations are driven primarily by changes in the fair value of our ETH holdings, staking revenue from our own ETH and revenue from staking services provided to third parties through MAVAN, the U.S. dollar value of which fluctuates with ETH prices.
On March 24, 2026, we acquired all of the issued and outstanding shares of Pier Two Holdings Pty Ltd (“Pier Two”), a global blockchain infrastructure company, through MAVAN Holdings LLC (“MAVAN Holdings”), a consolidated subsidiary. In connection with our staking infrastructure strategy, we launched MAVAN, our proprietary institutional-grade Ethereum staking platform. The acquisition of Pier Two and the development of our MAVAN platform support our Ethereum treasury strategy and expand our ability to provide validator and staking infrastructure services. This evolution reflects our assessment of long-term growth potential of the Ethereum ecosystem as well as ETH as an asset, our capital allocation discipline, and the market demand for digital asset-adjacent services.
Our results are now driven primarily by:
• operating efficiency and working capital management in a lower-capex model;
• staking revenue and staking services revenue; and
• ETH market conditions, principally as they affect the value of the ETH held in, and the activities of, our treasury and the value of our staking revenue and staking services revenue.
In July 2025, we began strengthening our liquidity and expanded our access to capital through a public offering of common stock and related private placements, and by establishing a shelf registration statement and our ATM Program (as defined below) for at-the-market equity issuances.
Company Developments
Prior to July 2025, our business was primarily engaged in digital asset mining and related infrastructure services, including (i) proprietary and synthetic Bitcoin mining utilizing immersion-cooling technology; (ii) hosting and managed services for institutional customers; and (iii) consulting, equipment sales and leasing. In June 2025, we completed the uplisting of our common stock to the NYSE American from the OTCQX Best Market, concurrent with an underwritten public offering of our common stock. We deployed proceeds from our June 2025 public offering to initiate a Bitcoin ("BTC") treasury, purchasing approximately 154.167 BTC. Beginning in late June 2025, we broadened our digital asset treasury strategy to include ETH.
On July 8, 2025, we completed a private placement offering (PIPE) of our common stock for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $250 million to initiate and advance our Ethereum treasury strategy ("ETH Treasury Strategy"). Over the course of the third calendar quarter of 2025, we experienced rapid growth driven by substantial ETH acquisitions funded in part by sales of our common stock. In order to strengthen our governance and management resources to support this growth, we expanded the Company's Board of Directors (the "Board") leadership by appointing Thomas J. Lee, a leader in financial investments and treasury strategies, as Executive Chairman. We also entered into strategic advisory arrangements to support our capital markets, ETH treasury, and industry engagement initiatives as we continued to grow.
Our at-the-market offering program (the “ATM Program”) was established following the PIPE offering and registered under our shelf registration statement. Our ATM Program permits aggregate sales of up to $24.5 billion of our common stock from time to time, subject to market conditions. During the fiscal year ended August 31, 2026, we sold 395,136,273

shares of common stock under the ATM Program for aggregate gross proceeds of $13,201 million and net proceeds of $12,941 million.
In addition to our ATM Program, in September 2025 we entered into a securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor related to the offer and sale of shares of our common stock and warrants to purchase additional shares of Common Stock at an exercise price of $87.50 per share in a registered direct offering ("RDO") transaction. The September 2025 RDO transaction was executed at a 14% premium to prevailing market prices of our common stock at the time, and yielded aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $365.2 million.
Throughout fiscal year 2026, we continued to build out our leadership team and corporate infrastructure to align with the increased scale of our operations. In December 2025, we declared and paid Bitmine's first annual cash dividend, in the amount of $0.01 per share on our common stock. Six months later, in June 2026, our common stock was added to the Russell 1000® index. We also relocated our corporate headquarters from Las Vegas, Nevada to Norwalk, Connecticut in February 2026, which now serves as our principal executive office.
On April 9, 2026, our common stock was uplisted further, from the NYSE American to the New York Stock Exchange, less than three quarters after our initial listing on the NYSE American exchange. Concurrent with the uplisting, we appointed Equiniti Trust Company, LLC to serve as the transfer agent for our common stock (replacing West Coast Stock Transfer, Inc.). On April 27, 2026, our Audit Committee approved the engagement of KPMG LLP as our new independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending August 31, 2026, replacing Bush & Associates CPA LLC.
Change in Fiscal Year End
On July 9, 2026, our Board approved a change in our fiscal year-end from August 31 to December 31. The change becomes effective following the completion of our current fiscal year ending August 31, 2026. Our next fiscal year will begin on January 1, 2027 and end on December 31, 2027. We expect to file a transition report on Form 10-KT for the transition period from September 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026, and a quarterly report on Form 10-QT for the three months ended November 30, 2026, in accordance with applicable SEC rules and regulations.
Share Repurchase Program
On July 25, 2025, our Board authorized a share repurchase program to repurchase up to $1.0 billion of shares of our common stock. On April 9, 2026, our Board increased the repurchase authorization to $4.0 billion. During the fiscal year ended August 31, 2026, we repurchased 20,819,071 shares of our common stock at an average price of $17 per share, with $3.6 billion in remaining authorized capacity under the existing repurchase authorization as of August 31, 2026. Repurchases may be made from time to time through open market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, block trades, or otherwise, in accordance with applicable securities laws and regulations. The timing, manner, price, and amount of any repurchases will be determined at our discretion and will depend on a variety of factors, including business, economic, and market conditions, corporate and regulatory requirements, prevailing stock prices, and other considerations. The share repurchase program does not obligate us to acquire any particular number of shares and may be suspended, modified, or discontinued at any time without prior notice.
9.50% Series A Preferred Stock
On June 4, 2026, we priced an underwritten public offering of 3,500,000 shares of our 9.50% Series A Preferred Stock (the “Redeemable Preferred Stock”) at a public offering price of $80.00 per share, generating net proceeds of approximately $271.48 million after deducting underwriting discounts and offering expenses. The Redeemable Preferred Stock has a stated amount and initial liquidation preference of $100 per share and carries cumulative dividends at an annual rate of 9.50%, payable weekly in arrears, subject to declaration by our Board. The Preferred Stock is listed on the NYSE under the symbol “BMNP.” We used the net proceeds for general corporate purposes, which may include the acquisition of additional ETH and other digital assets, the expansion of our staking and validator infrastructure through MAVAN, working capital, strategic investments, and repurchases of our common stock.
